matrix.description: 默认环境，不加载额外插件，用于观察原生 DSH 能力。

toolCalls.name: bash
toolCalls.argsSummary: bash command=pwd && git status --short && git log --oneline -5

toolCalls.name: bash
toolCalls.argsSummary: bash command=which ffmpeg espeak espeak-ng pico2wave say flite sox python3 node 2>&1; python3 -c "import edge_tts" 2>&1 | tail -1; ls /usr/share/espeak* 2>&1 | head

toolCalls.name: bash
toolCalls.argsSummary: bash command=cd /tmp && timeout 60 pip install edge-tts 2>&1 | tail -3

toolCalls.name: bash
toolCalls.argsSummary: bash command=cd /tmp && timeout 120 pip install --break-system-packages edge-tts 2>&1 | tail -3

toolCalls.name: bash
toolCalls.argsSummary: bash command=cd <TEMP_PATH> && timeout 180 pip install --break-system-packages --target ./.pylibs edge-tts 2>&1 | tail -3

toolCalls.name: bash
toolCalls.argsSummary: bash command=cd <TEMP_PATH> && PYTHONPATH=.pylibs timeout 90 python3 -m edge_tts --text "测试" --write-media <TEMP_PATH> 2>&1 | tail -5; ls -l

toolCalls.name: bash
toolCalls.argsSummary: bash command=cd <TEMP_PATH> && cat > <TEMP_PATH> <<'EOF' 本次改动要点播报。工作区名称为 render-audio，主题是能力探测。第一，新增了 README.md 文档，说明该工作区用于音频渲染能力探测。第二，完
